description: qwen3.6-35b-a3b weekdays, step 2: the exploratory battery as one document - probe, logit lens, the two knockout families, and a harvest whose activations a principal basis is fitted over. Independent steps ARE the parallelism; the only dependency here is harvest -> pca -> spectrum, and the runner derives it.

probe.description: Confirm the model does the task before spending compute on where.

logit_lens.description: Depth x position: what each cell would predict if the network stopped there.

knockout_attention.description: The (layer x head) grid, over the ten full-attention layers.

knockout_mlp.description: MLP bands at width 1, over the whole tower.

harvest.description: Residual stream at three depths, plus the mean-ablation reference.

pca.description: Centered principal basis over the mid-tower answer-slot activations.

spectrum.description: How much structure the top components carry, and at what rank it flattens.

head_grid.description: The knockout grid as a (layer x head) heatmap.
